translations: And not it is granted except
puzzle.hint: The rare spiritual reward of patience and noble character — turning enmity into devoted friendship.
puzzle.arabic: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
puzzle.verseEn: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
